headline: Get Flutternym
title: How to Get Flutternym | The Wind Healer | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Flutternym is number twenty eight, a Wind healer. Its Wind of Rejuvenation heals the whole team over time, and Purifying Dance removes debuffs. Find it in Nimbus Fields, Sea of Flowers and The Mistwoods, with a Timberline Form in Beast Fang Ridge. A Nighttime Form shows up only at night. At level twenty one it becomes Gracewing with a Gust Stone. Do you run a healer? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Flutternym is a Wind healer found in Nimbus Fields, Sea of Flowers and The Mistwoods, with regional and nighttime forms. At level 21 it evolves into Gracewing with a Gust Stone.
